newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: S&P rates WMC US$800 mln shelf 'A'.
newsitem.headline: S&P rates WMC US$800 mln shelf 'A'.

text.p: Standard and Poor's Corp said it has assigned its preliminary 'A' long-term rating to the US$800 million WMC Finance (USA) Ltd shelf registration, guaranteed by WMC Ltd.

S&P said the "A" credit rating on WMC reflected its strong capital structure and well diversified mining portfolio of long life operations with concentrations in nickel and alumina, which would cushion it against a planned A$1.25 billion capital spending requirement at the Olympic Dam copper and uranium site in South Australia. WMC successfully had pursued an international diversification strategy through acquisitions, development of existing assets, and mineral exploration.
S&P said the rating outlook was stable.
"The long-term rating anticipates management will continue to pursue development opportunities," it said.

"The rating assumes that the company successfully will meet increased medium term investment requirements with a combination of cash flow from existing operations, reinstatement of the dividend reinvestment plan, asset sales, and the benefits of cost reductions," S&P said.
